subtitle.text: Soldier: Heavy weapons stay at the armory. Rules of the sanctuary. You keep small arms, the axe, the shotgun, the MG.

ledger.text: Soldier: Heavy weapons stay at the armory. Rules of the sanctuary. You keep small arms, the axe, the shotgun, the MG.
A survivor joined the group.
Rocket launcher handed over to the armory.
Nadia: The army burns its dead behind the animal houses. Burns most of them.
Soldier: We found bodies in the feed store. They were supposed to be ashes.
Nadia: Stay on the path. They're nervous tonight — so are we.
Nadia: Gates are locked. We’re safe in here.
Major Hale (radio): They’re in the enclosures!
A survivor joined the group.
A survivor joined the group.
A survivor joined the group.
A survivor joined the group.
…research campus past Hollow Creek reports a counter-agent… evacuation from the Hollow Creek bridge at dawn… all units…
Major Hale: You're the courier. Heard about you. Get some rest — you've earned one night.
Nadia: Plaza is sealed. Through the pond gate: the keepers opened it for you!
Nadia: The pond’s red. It spread through every enclosure.
Nadia: The pond's west gate opens onto the lion habitat's east gate!
A survivor joined the group.
Nadia: They fed them from the feed store. Oh God.
Nadia: South gate's open. Take the west boulevard to the primate yard!
Nadia: That office window… they dragged the uniforms through it.
Nadia: The primate yard's east gate leads straight to the zebra paddock's west gate!
Nadia: The fence broke while they were running. They were bitten in the stampede.
Nadia: North gate's open. Cross the boulevard into the gorilla house!
A survivor joined the group.
Nadia: The vet’s tranquiliser rifle is still here. The door was forced.
Nadia: East gate's open. Down the service lane to the armored vehicle!
Hale: Hollow Creek. Get them out.
I'm sorry.
The APC engine roars as the survivors pull away.

phases.label: escape: Lead the group to the armored vehicle
depart: Cover the survivors while they board
